title: Estimate ammonia synthesis
hints: Count bonds from two ammonia molecules.
Subtract the formed-bond sum from the broken-bond sum.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Break $945+3(436)=2253$ kJ. Form $6(391)=2346$ kJ in magnitude. Difference is $-93$ kJ.
statement:
For $\ce{N2(g) + 3H2(g) -> 2NH3(g)}$, use N≡N 945, H–H 436 and N–H 391 kJ/mol. What is the estimate?

[_]{a}

explanations: The inventory is 1 triple, 3 H–H and 6 N–H.
Only three N–H bonds were counted.
Only one H–H bond was counted.
